name: Defense of the Ancients raises Ranger and party armor by its level-scaled amount (#6248)
contract: Defense of the Ancients 705094 promises 'increasing the Armor of party and raid members by ${$m1}'. Effect 0 is APPLY_AREA_AURA_RAID with SPELL_AURA_MOD_RESISTANCE 22, MiscValue 1 (armor), BasePoints 389, DieSides 1, RealPointsPerLevel 25 and BaseLevel/SpellLevel 30, so a level-60 caster resolves 389 + (60 - 30) * 25 + 1 = 1140. The spell is PASSIVE with SPELL_ATTR1_NO_AURA_ICON, so the client shows no buff icon by design. At the reported level 60, learning the passive must raise the Ranger's and a party member's armor by exactly 1140, and unlearning must remove it from the member.

steps.label: Put both players in one party
Defense of the Ancients reaches the Ranger
Defense of the Ancients reaches the party member
Unlearning removes it from the member
